articles.title: Voter Guide Meet the Judicial Candidates on the Nov Ballot
articles.excerpt: Triana was elected to the Third Court of Appeals in 2018 after serving at every level of Texas trial courts (Third Court of Appeals), including 14 years as a Travis County district judge (San Antonio Report).

articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Triana won the race for Texas Supreme Court, Place 8 with 5,033,586 votes (52.0%); opponent: Brett Busby (R) 4,643,375 (48.0%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
